$comment: §25 to §31. What a target is, before anything is asked of it.

classes.why: the preflight found nothing that excludes it
a track policy other than robots refuses it
ROBOTS_POLICY_V1's state machine returned an exclusion
the project already holds an explicit opt-out for this target
the requested resource is authentication-protected, so it fails the track's own public-accessibility precondition
the network safety contract refused every resolved address
the manifest URL is not http or https
a named operator entry in the exclusion registry
the project already holds a statement from this target restricting automated access relevant to this activity
something was found that the preflight cannot classify. It excludes rather than proceeds, because an unclassifiable condition is not an absence of one

public_visibility_and_permission.$comment: §26. The registry principle is preserved, restated for this track.

known_restrictions.an_excluded_target_may_be_reinstated: only by a separate recorded review

unknown_terms.$comment: §28. Neither a favourable fiction nor an impossible requirement.
unknown_terms.why_not_required: GOV-1 chose the track model rather than Model C, and importing a per-item human review here would reinstate the model that was rejected -- and would do it silently, as a side effect of a target policy.
unknown_terms.what_the_state_asserts: that this target's terms were not individually read. It asserts nothing about what they say in either direction.

preflight_ordering.$comment: Deterministic, so two runs over one corpus classify identically.
preflight_ordering.why_ordered: an unordered set of checks lets two implementations report different reasons for the same exclusion, and the reason is what a later reader uses to understand the population.

excluded_targets_and_the_population.$comment: §31 and Mission 1.71's invariant, which this must not break.
excluded_targets_and_the_population.an_excluded_target_becomes: a terminal accounting record in the NOT_ATTEMPTED_POLICY or NOT_ATTEMPTED_SAFETY missingness family
excluded_targets_and_the_population.why: the corpus records the population INTENT and the preflight records the governance decisions taken over it. Deleting excluded targets would merge two different facts and would shrink N, which is exactly the defect that closed the external routes in Mission 1.70.
